local stops = [makeColor([0,0,255]),makeColor([0,255,255]),makeColor([0,255,0]),makeColor([255,255,0]),makeColor([255,0,0])]
  values.map { v ->
 
local t = if (v < 0) 0 else if (v > 1) 1 else v
 
local seg = floor(t * 4)
    if (seg >= 4) { seg = 3 }
 
local lt = t * 4 - seg
 
local c1 = splitColor(stops[seg+1])
 
local c2 = splitColor(stops[seg+2])
 
local r = round(c1[2]*(1-lt)+c2[2]*lt)
 
local g = round(c1[3]*(1-lt)+c2[3]*lt)
 
local b = round(c1[4]*(1-lt)+c2[4]*lt)
    makeColor([r,g,b])
  }
}
println(makeHeatmap([0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1.0]))

7128.answer:
local samples = [[[1,1],1],[[0,0],0],[[1,0],0]]
local w7128 = [0.0,0.0]
local bias = 0.0
local lr7128 = 0.1
for (sample in samples) {
 
local x = sample[1]
 
local y = sample[2]
 
local pred = if (w7128[1]*x[1]+w7128[2]*x[2]+bias >= 0.5) 1 else 0
  if (pred != y) {
 
local err = y - pred
    w7128[1] = w7128[1] + lr7128*err*x[1]
    w7128[2] = w7128[2] + lr7128*err*x[2]
    bias = bias + lr7128*err
  }
}
println(w7128)

1191.problem: Write `buildHeap(list)` — simulate a min-heap using a list. Write `heapPush(heap, val)` and `heapPop(heap)`. Test.
1191.answer:
func heapPush(heap, val) = {
  heap.add(val)
 
local i = heap.listLen()
  while (i > 1 && heap[floor(i / 2)] > heap[i]) {
 
local temp = heap[floor(i / 2)]
    heap[floor(i / 2)] = heap[i]
    heap[i] = temp
    i = floor(i / 2)
  }
}
func heapPop(heap) = {
 
local mn = heap[1]
  heap[1] = heap[heap.listLen()]
  heap.remove(heap.listLen())
 
local i = 1
  while (i * 2 <= heap.listLen()) {
 
local mc = i * 2
    if (mc + 1 <= heap.listLen() && heap[mc + 1] < heap[mc]) mc = mc + 1
    if (heap[i] <= heap[mc]) break
 
local temp = heap[i]
    heap[i] = heap[mc]
    heap[mc] = temp
    i = mc
  }
  mn
}
local myHeap =[]
heapPush(myHeap, 3)
heapPush(myHeap, 1)
heapPush(myHeap, 2)
println(heapPop(myHeap))

func hexXOR(a, b) = {
 
local hexChars = "0123456789abcdef"
 
local result = ""
 
local i = 1
  while (i <= a.textLen()-1) {
 
local pairA = a.segment(i,2)
 
local pairB = b.segment(i,2)
 
local valA = hexToDec(pairA)
 
local valB = hexToDec(pairB)
 
local xored = valA ~ valB
    result = result _ hexChars.segment(floor(xored/16)+1,1) _ hexChars.segment(mod(xored,16)+1,1)
    i = i + 2
  }
  result
}

func evaluateSecurity(policy, resource, context) = {

10620.problem: Write a while loop implementing BFGS quasi-Newton optimisation on the Rosenbrock function.
10620.answer:
local x_bfgs = [0, 0]
local lr_bfgs = 0.001
local iters_bfgs = 10000

func rosenbrock(x) = {
  (1 - x[1]) ^ 2 + 100 * (x[2] - x[1] ^ 2) ^ 2
}

func rosenGrad(x) = {
 
local g1 = -2 * (1 - x[1]) - 400 * x[1] * (x[2] - x[1]^2)
 
local g2 = 200 * (x[2] - x[1]^2)
 
local listResult = [g1, g2]
  listResult
}

local H_inv = [[1, 0], [0, 1]]
local iter_b = 0

while (iter_b < iters_bfgs) {
 
local g = rosenGrad(x_bfgs)
 
local p = [-(H_inv[1][1]*g[1] + H_inv[1][2]*g[2]),
             -(H_inv[2][1]*g[1] + H_inv[2][2]*g[2])]
 
local alpha = lr_bfgs
 
local x_new = [x_bfgs[1] + alpha*p[1], x_bfgs[2] + alpha*p[2]]
 
local g_new = rosenGrad(x_new)
 
local s = [x_new[1]-x_bfgs[1], x_new[2]-x_bfgs[2]]
 
local y = [g_new[1]-g[1], g_new[2]-g[2]]
 
local sy = s[1]*y[1] + s[2]*y[2]
  if (abs(sy) > 0.0000000001) {
 
local rho = 1 / sy
 
local Hy = [H_inv[1][1]*y[1]+H_inv[1][2]*y[2], H_inv[2][1]*y[1]+H_inv[2][2]*y[2]]
 
local yHy = y[1]*Hy[1] + y[2]*Hy[2]
    H_inv[1][1] = H_inv[1][1] - rho*(s[1]*Hy[1]+Hy[1]*s[1]) + rho*(rho*yHy+1)*s[1]*s[1]
    H_inv[1][2] = H_inv[1][2] - rho*(s[1]*Hy[2]+Hy[1]*s[2]) + rho*(rho*yHy+1)*s[1]*s[2]
    H_inv[2][1] = H_inv[2][1] - rho*(s[2]*Hy[1]+Hy[2]*s[1]) + rho*(rho*yHy+1)*s[2]*s[1]
    H_inv[2][2] = H_inv[2][2] - rho*(s[2]*Hy[2]+Hy[2]*s[2]) + rho*(rho*yHy+1)*s[2]*s[2]
  }
  x_bfgs = x_new
  iter_b = iter_b + 1
}
println("BFGS result: " _ x_bfgs _ " f=" _ rosenbrock(x_bfgs))

10267.problem: Write `muller(f_name, x0, x1, x2, maxIter)` — Müller's method for root-finding. Test.
10267.answer:
func muller(f_name, x0, x1, x2, maxIter) = {
 
local p0 = x0
 
local p1 = x1
 
local p2 = x2
 
local root_m = p2
 
local iter_m = 0
  while (iter_m < maxIter) {
 
local f0 = p0^3 - p0 - 2
 
local f1 = p1^3 - p1 - 2
 
local f2 = p2^3 - p2 - 2
 
local h1 = p1 - p0
 
local h2 = p2 - p1
 
local d1 = (f1 - f0) / h1
 
local d2 = (f2 - f1) / h2
 
local a_m = (d2 - d1) / (h2 + h1)
 
local b_m = a_m * h2 + d2
 
local c_m = f2
 
local disc = b_m^2 - 4*a_m*c_m
 
local denom = if (abs(b_m + sqrt(abs(disc))) > abs(b_m - sqrt(abs(disc)))) b_m + sqrt(abs(disc)) else b_m - sqrt(abs(disc))
    if (abs(denom) < 0.000000000000001) {
      iter_m = maxIter
    }
 
local dx = -2 * c_m / denom
    root_m = p2 + dx
    p0 = p1
    p1 = p2
    p2 = root_m
    iter_m = iter_m + 1
    if (abs(dx) < 0.00000001) {
      iter_m = maxIter
    }
  }
  root_m
}

println("Muller root: " _ muller("cubic", 0, 1, 2, 50))

func tTest_2sample(a, b) = {
 
local na = a.listLen()
 
local nb = b.listLen()
 
local ma = a.reduce(0) { x, s -> x + s } / na
 
local mb = b.reduce(0) { x, s -> x + s } / nb
 
local va = a.map { x -> (x-ma)^2 }.reduce(0) { x, s -> x + s } / (na - 1)
 
local vb = b.map { x -> (x-mb)^2 }.reduce(0) { x, s -> x + s } / (nb - 1)
 
local se = sqrt(va/na + vb/nb)
 
local t_stat = (ma - mb) / se
 
local df = na + nb - 2
  {"t": t_stat, "df": df, "mean_a": ma, "mean_b": mb}
}

10788.problem: Write `deinterleave_bits(z)` — extract x and y from Morton code. Test round-trip.
10788.answer:
func deinterleave_bits(z) = {
 
local x = 0
 
local y = 0
 
local bit = 0
 
local zz = z
  while (zz > 0) {
    x = x + (zz % 2) * (2 ^ bit)
    zz = floor(zz / 2)
    y = y + (zz % 2) * (2 ^ bit)
    zz = floor(zz / 2)
    bit = bit + 1
  }
  {"x": x, "y": y}
}

func interleave_bits(x, y) = {
 
local z = 0
 
local xx = x
 
local yy = y
 
local bit = 0
  while (xx > 0 || yy > 0) {
    z = z + (xx % 2) * (2 ^ (2*bit))
    z = z + (yy % 2) * (2 ^ (2*bit+1))
    xx = floor(xx / 2)
    yy = floor(yy / 2)
    bit = bit + 1
  }
  z
}

local morton = interleave_bits(5, 3)
println("Morton: " _ morton)
println(deinterleave_bits(morton))

10792.problem: Write `ieee754_encode_simple(mantissa, exponent)` — simplified 8-bit float: sign+3-exp+4-mant. Test.
10792.answer:
func ieee754_encode_simple(mantissa, exponent) = {
 
local sign = if (mantissa < 0) 1 else 0
 
local bias = 3
 
local exp_biased = exponent + bias
 
local mant_abs = abs(mantissa)
 
local mant_int = round((mant_abs - floor(mant_abs)) * 16) % 16
 
local byte_val = sign * 128 + exp_biased * 16 + mant_int
  {"sign": sign, "exp": exp_biased, "mantissa_bits": mant_int, "byte": byte_val}
}

println(ieee754_encode_simple(1.5, 0))
println(ieee754_encode_simple(-1.25, 1))

11056.problem: Write `liveIntervalColor(var, start, end)` — hash var name to hue, brightness by interval length. Test.
11056.answer:
func liveIntervalColor(var, start, end) = {
 
local hash = 0
  for (i: 1 .. var.textLen()) {
    hash = (hash * 31 + var.segment(i,1).textLen()) % 360
  }
 
local length = end - start
 
local brightness = if (length > 20) 200 else round(100 + length * 5)
 
local hue = hash
 
local r = round(abs(cos(radians(hue))) * brightness)
 
local g = round(abs(cos(radians(hue - 120))) * brightness)
 
local b = round(abs(cos(radians(hue - 240))) * brightness)
  makeColor([r, g, b])
}

println(liveIntervalColor("x", 0, 10))
println(liveIntervalColor("temp_var", 5, 30))

global projectiles = []

func fire(x, y, angle, speed) {
  this.projectiles.add({"x": x, "y": y, "angle": angle, "speed": speed})
}

func stepProjectiles() {
 
local updated = []
  for (p in this.projectiles) {
 
local nx = p.get("x", 0) + cos(p.get("angle", 0)) * p.get("speed", 0)
 
local ny = p.get("y", 0) + sin(p.get("angle", 0)) * p.get("speed", 0)
 
local p2 = copyDict(p)
    p2.set("x", nx)
    p2.set("y", ny)
    updated.add(p2)
  }
  this.projectiles = updated
}

fire(0, 0, 0, 5)
fire(10, 10, 1.57, 3)
stepProjectiles()
stepProjectiles()
stepProjectiles()
println(this.projectiles)

2287.answer:
func rk4_step(x, v, dt) = {
 
local k1x = v
 
local k1v = -x
 
local k2x = v + 0.5 * dt * k1v
 
local k2v = -(x + 0.5 * dt * k1x)
 
local k3x = v + 0.5 * dt * k2v
 
local k3v = -(x + 0.5 * dt * k2x)
 
local k4x = v + dt * k3v
 
local k4v = -(x + dt * k3x)
 
local nx = x + dt / 6 * (k1x + 2 * k2x + 2 * k3x + k4x)
 
local nv = v + dt / 6 * (k1v + 2 * k2v + 2 * k3v + k4v)
 
local listResult = [nx, nv]
  listResult
}
local state = [1, 0]
for (i: 1 .. 5) {
 
local ns = rk4_step(state[1], state[2], 0.1)
  state = ns
  println(state)
}

func julia(zx, zy, cx, cy, maxIter) = {
 
local iter = 0
 
local x = zx
 
local y = zy
  while (iter < maxIter && x * x + y * y < 4) {
 
local tmp = x * x - y * y + cx
    y = 2 * x * y + cy
    x = tmp
    iter = iter + 1
  }
  iter
}

2326.problem: Write `flocking(birds, dt)` — simplified Boids: apply separation, alignment, cohesion forces. Simulate 5 birds for 3 steps.
2326.answer:
func flocking(birds, dt) = {
 
local result = copyList(birds)
  for (stepVar: 1 .. 3) {
 
local updated = []
    for (i: 1 .. result.listLen()) {
 
local b = result[i]
 
local sepX = 0
 
local sepY = 0
 
local avgVx = 0
 
local avgVy = 0
 
local avgX = 0
 
local avgY = 0
      for (j: 1 .. result.listLen()) {
        if (i != j) {
 
local o = result[j]
 
local dx = b.get("x",0) - o.get("x",0)
 
local dy = b.get("y",0) - o.get("y",0)
 
local d = sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)
          if (d < 2 && d > 0) {
            sepX = sepX + dx/d
            sepY = sepY + dy/d
          }
          avgVx = avgVx + o.get("vx",0)
          avgVy = avgVy + o.get("vy",0)
          avgX = avgX + o.get("x",0)
          avgY = avgY + o.get("y",0)
        }
      }
 
local n = result.listLen() - 1
 
local nvx = b.get("vx",0) + 0.1*sepX + 0.05*(avgVx/n - b.get("vx",0)) + 0.01*(avgX/n - b.get("x",0))
 
local nvy = b.get("vy",0) + 0.1*sepY + 0.05*(avgVy/n - b.get("vy",0)) + 0.01*(avgY/n - b.get("y",0))
 
local b2 = copyDict(b)
      b2.set("x", b.get("x",0) + nvx*dt)
      b2.set("y", b.get("y",0) + nvy*dt)
      b2.set("vx", nvx)
      b2.set("vy", nvy)
      updated.add(b2)
    }
    result = updated
  }
  result
}
local birds = [{"x":0,"y":0,"vx":1,"vy":0},{"x":1,"y":0,"vx":0,"vy":1},{"x":0,"y":1,"vx":-1,"vy":0},{"x":-1,"y":0,"vx":0,"vy":-1},{"x":0,"y":-1,"vx":1,"vy":1}]
println(flocking(birds, 0.1))

2646.problem: Write `resolveCollisions(entities)` — detect and respond to pairwise collisions (circle vs circle). Return updated list.
2646.answer:
func resolveCollisions(entities) = {
 
local updated = copyList(entities)
  for (i: 1 .. updated.listLen()) {
    for (j: i+1 .. updated.listLen()) {
 
local a = updated[i]
 
local b = updated[j]
 
local dx = b.get("x",0) - a.get("x",0)
 
local dy = b.get("y",0) - a.get("y",0)
 
local dist = sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)
 
local minDist = a.get("r",0) + b.get("r",0)
      if (dist < minDist && dist > 0) {
 
local overlap = (minDist - dist) / 2
 
local nx = dx / dist
 
local ny = dy / dist
 
local a2 = copyDict(a)
 
local b2 = copyDict(b)
        a2.set("x", a.get("x",0) - nx * overlap)
        a2.set("y", a.get("y",0) - ny * overlap)
        b2.set("x", b.get("x",0) + nx * overlap)
        b2.set("y", b.get("y",0) + ny * overlap)
        updated[i] = a2
        updated[j] = b2
      }
    }
  }
  updated
}
local ents = [{"id":1,"x":0,"y":0,"r":5},{"id":2,"x":4,"y":0,"r":5}]
println(resolveCollisions(ents))

2695.problem: Write `simulateGrowth(ecosystem, ticks)` — predator-prey Lotka-Volterra step. Print population each tick.
2695.answer:
func simulateGrowth(ecosystem, ticks) {
 
local prey = ecosystem.get("prey", 100)
 
local predator = ecosystem.get("predator", 10)
 
local alpha = 0.1
 
local beta = 0.02
 
local gamma = 0.3
 
local delta = 0.01
  for (t: 1 .. ticks) {
 
local newPrey = prey + (alpha * prey - beta * prey * predator)
 
local newPredator = predator + (delta * prey * predator - gamma * predator)
    prey = newPrey
    predator = newPredator
    println("Tick " _ t _ ": prey=" _ round(prey) _ " predator=" _ round(predator))
  }
}
simulateGrowth({"prey": 100, "predator": 10}, 10)

2305.problem: Write `closestPointOnSegment(px, py, ax, ay, bx, by)` — project point onto segment, clamp to [0,1]. Return `[x, y]`.
2305.answer:
func closestPointOnSegment(px, py, ax, ay, bx, by) = {
 
local dx = bx - ax
 
local dy = by - ay
 
local lenSq = dx * dx + dy * dy
 
local t = 0
  if (lenSq != 0) {
    t = ((px - ax) * dx + (py - ay) * dy) / lenSq
    t = if (t < 0) 0 else if (t > 1) 1 else t
  }
 
local listResult = [ax + t * dx, ay + t * dy]
  listResult
}
println(closestPointOnSegment(3, 0, 0, 0, 5, 0))
println(closestPointOnSegment(6, 0, 0, 0, 5, 0))

3135.problem: Write a for loop generating the De Bruijn sequence for alphabet size 2 and order 3 by following the De Bruijn graph.
3135.answer:
local db = []
local dbState = [0,0,0]
local dbVisited = []
local dbSteps = 0
while (dbSteps < 8) {
 
local key = dbState.join("")
  if (!dbVisited.containsItem(key)) {
    dbVisited.add(key)
  }
 
local newBit = (dbState[1] + dbState[2]) % 2
  db.add(dbState[3])
  dbState = [newBit, dbState[1], dbState[2]]
  dbSteps = dbSteps + 1
}
println(db)

local saWord = "abbc"
local saLen = saWord.textLen()
local saStates = [{}]
local saLast = 1
local saSize = 1
for (ci: 1 .. saLen) {
 
local ch = saWord.segment(ci, 1)
 
local cur = saSize + 1
  saStates.add({})
  saSize = saSize + 1
 
local p = saLast
  while (p != 0 && !saStates[p].containsKey(ch)) {
    saStates[p].set(ch, cur)
    p = saStates[p].get("link", 0)
  }
  saLast = cur
}
println("States: " _ saStates.listLen())

local p0 = controls[1]
 
local p1 = controls[2]
 
local p2 = controls[3]
 
local p3 = controls[4]
 
local mt = 1 - t
 
local x = mt^3*p0[1] + 3*mt^2*t*p1[1] + 3*mt*t^2*p2[1] + t^3*p3[1]
 
local y = mt^3*p0[2] + 3*mt^2*t*p1[2] + 3*mt*t^2*p2[2] + t^3*p3[2]
 
local listResult = [x, y]
  listResult
}

func gouraudShading(vertices, normals, lightDir, baseColor) = {
 
local colors = []
  for (i: 1 .. vertices.listLen()) {
 
local n = normals[i]
 
local dot = n[1]*lightDir[1] + n[2]*lightDir[2] + n[3]*lightDir[3]
 
local d = if (dot > 0) dot else 0
 
local ka = 0.2
 
local kd = 0.8
 
local intensity = ka + kd * d
 
local r = floor(baseColor[1] * intensity)
 
local g = floor(baseColor[2] * intensity)
 
local b = floor(baseColor[3] * intensity)
    colors.add(makeColor([if (r>255) 255 else r, if (g>255) 255 else g, if (b>255) 255 else b]))
  }
  colors
}

4490.answer:
func curvature(pts) = {
 
local result = []
  for (i: 2 .. pts.listLen()-1) {
 
local dx1 = pts[i][1]-pts[i-1][1]
 
local dy1 = pts[i][2]-pts[i-1][2]
 
local dx2 = pts[i+1][1]-pts[i][1]
 
local dy2 = pts[i+1][2]-pts[i][2]
 
local cross = dx1*dy2-dy1*dx2
 
local len1 = sqrt(dx1*dx1+dy1*dy1)
 
local len2 = sqrt(dx2*dx2+dy2*dy2)
 
local denom = len1*len2*(len1+len2)/2
    result.add(if (denom > 0) cross/denom else 0)
  }
  result
}

4574.problem: Given a dict of animation keyframes with 2D position and orientation, compute intermediate frames by linearly interpolating between keyframes.
4574.answer:
func interpolateKeyframes(keyframes, numFrames) = {
 
local frames = []
  for (i: 1 .. numFrames) {
 
local t = (i-1) / (numFrames-1)
 
local kn = keyframes.listLen()
 
local ki = floor(t * (kn-1)) + 1
 
local kj = if (ki >= kn) kn else ki + 1
 
local lt = t * (kn-1) - (ki-1)
 
local a = keyframes[ki]
 
local b = keyframes[kj]
 
local x = a.get("x",0) + lt*(b.get("x",0)-a.get("x",0))
 
local y = a.get("y",0) + lt*(b.get("y",0)-a.get("y",0))
 
local rot = a.get("rot",0) + lt*(b.get("rot",0)-a.get("rot",0))
    frames.add({"x":x,"y":y,"rot":rot,"frame":i})
  }
  frames
}

  spiralGrid.add(row)

4503.problem: Given a list of 3D points sampled from a plane, fit the best-fit plane using principal component analysis on the point covariances.
4503.answer:
func fitPlane(pts) = {
 
local n = pts.listLen()
 
local cx = 0
 
local cy = 0
 
local cz = 0
  for (p in pts) { cx=cx+p[1] cy=cy+p[2] cz=cz+p[3] }
  cx=cx/n cy=cy/n cz=cz/n
 
local xx=0
local xy=0
local xz=0
local yy=0
local yz=0
local zz=0
  for (p in pts) {
 
local rx=p[1]-cx
local ry=p[2]-cy
local rz=p[3]-cz
    xx=xx+rx*rx xy=xy+rx*ry xz=xz+rx*rz yy=yy+ry*ry yz=yz+ry*rz zz=zz+rz*rz
  }
 
local nx = yy*zz-yz*yz
 
local ny = xz*yz-xy*zz
 
local nz = xy*yz-yy*xz
 
local len = sqrt(nx*nx+ny*ny+nz*nz)
  if (len > 0) { {"normal":[nx/len,ny/len,nz/len],"centroid":[cx,cy,cz]} }
  else { {"normal":[0,0,1],"centroid":[cx,cy,cz]} }
}
println(fitPlane([[0,0,0],[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[1,1,0.1],[0.5,0.5,0.05]]))

20260.problem: Write `correlation(x, y)` — Pearson correlation coefficient. Test `([1,2,3,4,5],[2,4,6,8,10])` → `1.0` (perfect positive).
20260.answer:
func correlation(x, y) = {
 
local n = x.listLen()
 
local mx = x.reduce(0) { v, s -> v+s } / n
 
local my = y.reduce(0) { v, s -> v+s } / n
 
local num = 0
 
local dx2 = 0
 
local dy2 = 0
  for (i: 1 .. n) {
    num = num + (x[i]-mx)*(y[i]-my)
    dx2 = dx2 + (x[i]-mx)^2
    dy2 = dy2 + (y[i]-my)^2
  }
  num / sqrt(dx2*dy2)
}
println(correlation([1,2,3,4,5],[2,4,6,8,10]))

func linearRegression(x, y) = {
 
local n = x.listLen()
 
local mx = x.reduce(0) { v, s -> v+s } / n
 
local my = y.reduce(0) { v, s -> v+s } / n
 
local num = 0
local den = 0
  for (i: 1 .. n) {

}

20365.answer:
func metaphone(s) = {
 
local result = s.uppercase()
  result = result.replace("PH","F").replace("CK","K").replace("SCH","SK")
  result = result.replace("TH","0").replace("GN","N")
 
local vowels = ["A","E","I","O","U"]
 
local out = ""
  for (i: 1 .. result.textLen()) {
 
local ch = result.segment(i,1)
    if (!(vowels.containsItem(ch)) || i == 1) out = out _ ch
  }
  out
}
println(metaphone("Smith"))
println(metaphone("Smythe"))
